script:
UPI_METHOD = 'UPI'

upi_needed = doc.get('custom_preferred_payment_method') == UPI_METHOD
upi = doc.get('custom_upi_id')

if upi_needed and (not upi or not upi.strip()):
    frappe.throw('UPI ID is required when Preferred Payment Method is UPI.')
